items.question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses ask which beings know through devotion on earth.
The preceding verse lists female figures such as the dove-woman, vulture-woman, swan-woman, and nail-woman.
This verse continues the enumeration with further female figures.
items.inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and guli-woman are likewise included among those who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identity or species implied by sararī and gūlī is not fully certain from the verse alone.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sarari-woman, or the guli-woman likewise.
